posts.meta_description: 2,993 likes, 51 comments - ted on October 28, 2026: "Good jobs aren’t just good for society — they’re good for business, says social impact investor Warren Valdmanis. In his TED Talk, he outlines the 4 ingredients of a job that truly works for people, which go beyond just the size of a paycheck, and shares why making employees feel valued and supported is key to building great companies. Visit the link in @TED’s bio to watch the full talk.".

posts.meta_description: 925 likes, 18 comments - ted on October 23, 2026: "Pull up a barstool (and a high chair) for the “Witching Hour,” the toddler-friendly gathering hosted by writer Stacy McLachlan. In her @tedxvancouver Talk, she explores why the early years of parenting can be so lonely — and makes the case for creating spaces where kids are free to be kids and parents are free to be people, all together. Visit the link in @TED's bio to watch the full talk.".

posts.meta_description: 18K likes, 214 comments - ted on October 24, 2026: "A bully’s power is borrowed power — and we can refuse to hand it over, says social psychologist @AmyCuddy. In her TED Talk, she recounts being relentlessly targeted in a public campaign, shares research on how quickly bullying spreads and explains why standing up for each other in small ways is the key to stopping it. Visit the link in our bio to watch her talk.".

posts.meta_description: 2,127 likes, 29 comments - ted on October 21, 2026: "With enough money, you can influence public perception by heavily betting on something — making prediction markets potentially more dangerous than they seem, says philosopher and @tedfellow Carissa Véliz. In her TED Talk, she breaks down the dangers of predictions and how those in power may be using them to sell their version of the future. Visit the link in @TED’s bio to learn more.".

posts.meta_description: 1,177 likes, 123 comments - ted on October 19, 2026: "How do you come back from a mistake that turns into widespread public shame? @reclaimingwithmonica host @monica_lewinsky knows a lot about it. In this conversation with How to Be a Better Human host @ChrisiDuffy, she opens up about how she’s found healing over the years and what it takes to overcome adversity. They dig into making mistakes in an online world, the difference between cancel culture and accountability culture and how surviving trauma can lead to more empathy. Visit the link in bio to listen to their full conversation.".

posts.meta_description: 9,304 likes, 109 comments - ted on October 17, 2026: "How often do you think about your own death? If your answer is never, death doula Alua Arthur (@alualoveslife) thinks you should reconsider. In her TED Talk, she shares stories from her experience supporting people through their end-of-life transitions and what it taught her about our limited time on this planet. Visit the link in our bio to watch the full talk and challenge yourself to think about your own life through the lens of death.".
